items.title: 13.3.2 Types of Animals on the basis ability of Thermoregulation (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of poikilotherms and homeotherms (PDF 8).

blocks.text: Poikilotherms woh janwar hain jo apne jism ka darja-e-hararat ek tang had (narrow limits) mein qaim nahin rakh sakte. In ka darja-e-hararat kafi badalta rehta hai aur aam taur par mahol ke darja-e-hararat ke barabar hota hai. Kitab ke mutabiq tamam invertebrates poikilotherms hain. Vertebrates mein machhliyan, amphibians aur reptiles bhi poikilotherms hain.

blocks.title: Kam khane mein guzara
blocks.text: Poikilotherms ko ek jaisa darja-e-hararat qaim rakhne ke liye bohat zyada khana nahin khana parta (khana jism ka "eendhan" hai). Is liye yeh aisi jagahon par bhi zinda reh lete hain jahan khurak kam hai aur jahan koi homeotherm bhook se mar jaye.

Yeh janwar mahol ke upar neeche hone ke bawajood apne jism ka andar ka darja-e-hararat kafi had tak ek jaisa rakhte hain. Yeh dimagh mein "thermostat" (hypothalamus) istemal karte hain jo thanda karne ya garam karne ka amal shuru karta hai. Misalen: mammals aur birds. Maslan insaan bohat thande ya bohat garam mahol mein bhi apna andar ka darja-e-hararat taqreeban 37°C rakhte hain.

blocks.prompt: Homeotherms aur poikilotherms mein farq bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Homeotherms taqreeban mustaqil darja-e-hararat rakhte (parinde, mammals) magar bohat khana chahte hain; poikilotherms darja-e-hararat mahol ke saath badalne dete (machhliyan, reptiles) aur kahin kam khana chahte hain.

items: Poikilotherms: darja-e-hararat mahol ke saath badalta hai; kam khane mein guzara; invertebrates, machhliyan, amphibians, reptiles.
Homeotherms: hypothalamus (thermostat) se darja-e-hararat taqreeban ek jaisa; mammals aur birds; insaan taqreeban 37°C.
